name: 鍾朝安
objective:
本課程主要內容將會介紹: 
1 何謂半導體。  2 半導體的特性。  3 半導體的取得來源與方法介紹。 4 半導體材料的不同應用。 5 半導體的相關產業鏈介紹。 6 與半導體相關產業的工作介紹。
The main contents of this course will introduce: 
1 What is named semiconductor. 
2. Characteristics of semiconductors. 
3. Introduction of methods to access semiconductors materials. 
4. Different applications of semiconductor materials. 
5. Introduction to the semiconductor industry and its supply chain. 
6. Introduction to work content in semiconductor industry.
課程進度(1-16週):
W01-W02    課程簡介與評分標準，半導體起源/Course Introduction & Grading Criteria; Origins of Semiconductors
W03-W04    半導體材料介紹：取得來源與製造方法/Introduction to Semiconductor Materials: Sources and Manufacturing Methods
W05-W06    半導體製程介紹：黃光製程、相關設備與產業發展/Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: Photolithography Process, Related Equipment, and Industry Development
W07-W08    半導體製程介紹：蝕刻製程、相關設備與產業發展/Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: Etching Process, Related Equipment, and Industry Development
W09-W10    半導體製程介紹：鍍膜製程、相關設備與產業發展/Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: Thin Film Deposition Process, Related Equipment, and Industry Development
W11-W12    半導體製程介紹：設計產業、相關技術與產業發展/Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: IC Design Industry, Related Technologies, and Industry Development
W13-W14    半導體製程介紹：先進封裝、相關設備與產業發展/Introduction to Semiconductor Processes: Advanced Packaging, Related Equipment, and Industry Development
W15-W16    半導體產業人才培育與職涯發展、期末報告/Talent Cultivation and Career Development in the Semiconductor Industry; Final Presentations
W17-W18    期末報告/Final Presentations
W19-W20    期末報告/Final Presentations (If necessary)
